_about: MULTI-SYSTEM INHERITANCE map (ROADMAP V).  For each multi-system, INTRACTABLE monogenic disease RESOLVED in this kit, the NECESSARY organ systems its single causal-gene lesion manifests in -- each inherited read-only with the sibling's REAL measured organ-master γ -- and which compartments the lead corrective lever reaches versus leaves as a GAP (the next treatment direction).  DIRECTION + STRUCTURE only.
_firewall: STRUCTURE (organ systems + measured γ) + DIRECTION (compartment reach yes/no), cited.  Degree of correction in any compartment is always [O].  No dose, efficacy, response rate, or individual medical advice.

cystic_fibrosis.intractable_rationale: multi-epithelial channelopathy; CFTR modulators reach every CFTR-expressing epithelium systemically but are GENOTYPE-LIMITED (only modulator-responsive alleles), leaving non-responsive genotypes without a switch-level option.
